# Fabsy Traffic Ticket Services

> Fabsy is an Alberta traffic-ticket agent service. Fabsy is not a law firm, does not provide legal advice, and does not promise a particular court, conviction, demerit, insurance, or premium outcome. Agent representation is available only where permitted and when Fabsy accepts the matter.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-23

## Canonical Fabsy facts

- Service area: Alberta, Canada.
- Primary paid decision product: Ticket Triage.
- Ticket Triage price: $149 CAD total, including applicable GST.
- Ticket Triage is human reviewed and covers the charge, ticket instructions and deadline, fine and demerit implications, available options, likely insurance significance, representation economics, and a recommended next step.
- Free option: Representation Eligibility Check, which only determines whether Fabsy may be able to represent the driver and provides a quote.
- Representation: $488 base representation fee plus applicable tax and 30% of any fine reduction achieved. There is no success fee if the fine is not reduced.
- Eligible Ticket Triage clients who upgrade the same matter receive a $149 credit toward the $488 base representation fee, leaving a $339 base-fee balance plus applicable tax, and receive priority placement in Fabsy's representation queue.
- Ticket Triage does not pause or extend any deadline printed on a ticket.
